answer: A scripted farm thus has to pad 177 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the thread challenge, the yarrow audit can replay the beacon history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4312 identities would post 4011 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
